REGULATION II OF 1998
FRONTIER CRIMES (AMENDMENT) REGULATION 1998
A Regulation further to amend the
Frontier Crimes Regulation, 1901
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 20th November, 1998]
F.No.2(3)/98-Pub., dated
19-11-1998.--The following Regulation made by the President is hereby published
for general information:---
Whereas it is expedient further
to amend the Frontier Crimes (Regulation), 1901 (Regulation No.III of 1901), in
its application to the Federally Administered Tribal Areas for the purpose
hereinafter appearing,
Whereas
clause (5) of Article 247 of the Constitution of the Islamic
Republic
of Pakistan provides that the President may, with respect to any matter make
regulations for the peace and good Government of a Federally Administered
Tribal Areas or any part thereof;
Therefore, in exercise of the
powers aforesaid, the President is pleased to make the following Regulation:---
1. Short title, extent and commencement.--(1) This Regulation may
be called the Frontier Crimes (Amendment) Regulation, 1998.
(2) It shall extend to the whole
of the Federally Administered Tribal Areas.
(3) It shall come into force at
once.
2. Amendment of Second Schedule Regulation No. III of 1901.--In the
Frontier Crimes Regulation, 1901 (Regulation No.111 of 1901), in the Second
Schedule, after entry 2-A, the following new entry shall be inserted, namely:--
2-B. Any
offence punishable under any of the provisions of the Employment of Children
Act, 1991 (V of 1991)."
sections.punishment:
punishable under any of the provisions of the Employment of Children
